# Adjudication Task — Chapter 220

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃220화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|원명훈이 떠났다. 내 태도에 이를 갈면서도 선뜻 덤비지 못하던 그의 모습을 떠올리자 실소가 새어 나왔다.
  6|
  7|‘그랬다면 후회하게 만들어 줬을 텐데.’
  8|
  9|하이에나 같은 인간이다.
 10|
 11|상대가 약한 모습을 보이면 이빨을 드러내고, 강한 모습을 보이면 이빨을 감춘다.
 12|
 13|지금까지 보여 준 모습을 되짚어 보면 8년 전의 그 사건도 그의 성향과 무관하지 않을 것이다.
 14|
 15|‘운 좋은 줄 알아라.’
 16|
 17|하이에나가 아무리 날고 기어 봤자 결국 짐승.
 18|
 19|꼬리를 내릴 줄 아는 놈은 겁을 줘서 쫓아내면 그만이다.
 20|
 21|내 어깨에 이빨을 박기도 전에 굳이 손에 피를 묻힐 이유도, 생각도 없었다. 짐승 따위가 아니라 진짜 괴물을 상대하기 전에는 더더욱.
 22|
 23|- 캬우우우우우!
 24|
 25|조금씩 가까워지는 검은 점.
 26|
 27|분노에 찬 포효가 지평선 끝에서부터 울려 퍼졌다.
 28|
 29|내가 놈의 정체를 알아차린 것처럼, 놈도 마찬가지였다.
 30|
 31|‘그래, 너도 나를 기억하는구나.’
 32|
 33|그거면 된 거다. 반쯤 미친 네임드 몬스터를 상대하게 됐지만 두려움과 흥분은 없었다.
 34|
 35|다만 한 가지, 목 안의 가시처럼 걸리는 부분이 있었다.
 36|
 37|“왜 안 가셨어요?”
 38|
 39|느슨하게 팔짱을 낀 최 팀장이 나를 빤히 바라봤다.
 40|
 41|곧이어 돌아온 건 대답이 아니라 질문이었다.
 42|
 43|“누구한테 물어본 겁니까?”
 44|
 45|“모두한테요.”
 46|
 47|나는 주위를 쓱 훑었다. 끝없이 펼쳐진 황무지, 드문드문 늘어선 바위와 나무를 배경으로 네 사람이 서 있었다.
 48|
 49|최 팀장과 김 집사. 그리고 임꺽정과 송송이.
 50|
 51|그들 중 단 한 사람도 자리를 뜨지 않았다.
 52|
 53|“지금 오고 있는 게 네임드 몬스터인 건 아시죠?”
 54|
 55|“저희 모두 잘 알고 있습니다.”
 56|
 57|“그럼 이야기가 쉽겠네요. 위험하니까 지금이라도 피하세요.”
 58|
 59|“어디로 피합니까?”
 60|
 61|“어디겠어요? 우리가 들어왔던 출구지.”
 62|
 63|“스타 길드는 같이 도망치기에 썩 괜찮은 파트너는 아니죠. 더군다나 그쪽 길드장이랑 척을 졌을 경우에는.”
 64|
 65|글쎄, 내 생각은 다른데.
 66|
 67|아직 알려지지는 않았지만 김 집사는 A급 마법사다. 그것도 대격변이라는 초유의 전쟁을 온몸으로 겪은.
 68|
 69|머릿수만 많았지, 당장 나를 제외하고 원명훈이 이끄는 스타 길드와 싸워도 결코 밀리지 않는다.
 70|
 71|“핑계가 좋네요.”
 72|
 73|빙긋 웃는 나를 최 팀장이 빤히 응시했다.
 74|
 75|“진태경 씨.”
 76|
 77|“안 돼요.”
 78|
 79|말이 나오기도 전에 단칼에 잘라 냈지만 이대로 순순히 물러날 최 팀장이 아니었다.
 80|
 81|“덕분에 오도 가도 못 하는 상황에 처했으니 몇 가지 정도는 물어볼 자격이 있다고 생각하는데요.”
 82|
 83|젠장, 그러네.
 84|
 85|나는 마지못해 대답했다.
 86|
 87|“……대신 짧게.”
 88|
 89|“지금 오고 있는 저 몬스터, 3년 전 그 일과 연관이 있는 놈입니까?”
 90|
 91|망설이다가 고개를 끄덕였다.
 92|
 93|“물러서지 않겠군요.”
 94|
 95|“…….”
 96|
 97|침묵은 곧 긍정.
 98|
 99|최 팀장이 낮게 한숨을 내쉬었다.
100|
101|“진태경 씨, 상대는 네임드 몬스터입니다.”
102|
103|“그건 처음 알았네요. 제 눈에는 그냥 죽일 놈인데.”
104|
105|“이건 냉정하게 생각해야 할 문제입니다.”
106|
107|“지금 제가 그 정도로 불안정해 보입니까?”
108|
109|“그건…….”
110|
111|최 팀장은 입을 다물었다.
112|
113|지금의 나는 그 어느 때보다 냉정하다. 미친 듯이 방망이질 치는 심장과는 달리 머릿속에서는 놈을 상대할 방법을 수없이 떠올리고 있다.
114|
115|“최 팀장님.”
116|
117|“……?”
118|
119|“제 인생 모토, 예전에 몇 번 말씀드린 적이 있었죠.”
120|
121|말없이 지켜보던 임꺽정이 대신 대답했다.
122|
123|“가늘고 길게.”
124|
125|“아저씨도 기억하시네요.”
126|
127|“넌 희한한 놈이었어. 젊은 녀석이면 한 번쯤 큰 꿈을 가져 볼 만도 한데…… 그러지 않았지.”
128|
129|“제가 굴곡진 인생은 별로 안 좋아해서.”
130|
131|이번에는 김 집사가 미소짓는 얼굴로 대답했다.
132|
133|“그런 것 치고는 멀리 와 버린 것 같군요.”
134|
135|“그래서 바꿨죠.”
136|
137|“굵고 길게. 맞습니까?”
138|
139|“네. 가늘게 살기에는 이미 글렀고, 이렇게 된 이상 최대한 굵고 길게 살아 보려고요.”
140|
141|“좋군요. 혹시 원하신다면…….”
142|
143|무슨 말을 할지 알 것 같다.
144|
145|나는 가만히 고개를 가로저었다. 김 집사는 더욱 중요한 일을 맡아야 하는 사람이다.
146|
147|“저는 괜찮습니다. 다른 분들을 지켜 주세요.”
148|
149|“알겠습니다. 굳이 말씀하지 않으셔도 제가 마땅히 해야 할 일, 최선을 다하죠.”
150|
151|김 집사의 시원시원한 대답에 송이 씨가 황당한 얼굴로 물었다.
152|
153|“네임드 몬스터를 상대로 혼자 싸우라니, 다들 제정신이에요? 까딱하면 다 죽어요, 다!”
154|
155|“그렇게 말씀하시는 송이 씨는 왜 안 가셨습니까?”
156|
157|“……그러게요. 내가 왜 여기 있지?”
158|
159|나는 골똘히 생각에 잠긴 그녀를 바라보다가 문득 입을 열었다.
160|
161|“송이 씨.”
162|
163|“안 돼요.”
164|
165|“안 됩니다.”
166|
167|“진태경 헌터님. 제발.”
168|
169|반응 뭐야, 이거.
170|
171|이제 겨우 운만 뗐을 뿐인데 송이 씨에 이어 최 팀장과 김 집사까지 나서서 단칼에 잘라 버렸다.
172|
173|“태경아, 된다.”
174|
175|그나마 꺽정이 형이 유일한 원군이구나.
176|
177|나는 세 사람을 향해 억울한 얼굴로 중얼거렸다.
178|
179|“저 아직 말도 안 꺼냈습니다.”
180|
181|송이 씨가 대답했다.
182|
183|“그래서 안 된다는 거예요.”
184|
185|“제가 무슨 말을 할 줄 아시고.”
186|
187|“음. 고백?”
188|
189|순간 머리가 띵해졌다.
190|
191|누군가 망치로 후려친 것처럼 뒤통수가 얼얼하다.
192|
193|“헉, 그걸 어떻게.”
194|
195|“세상에, 그걸 모를 수가 있어요?”
196|
197|“티, 티가 많이 났나?”
198|
199|“네. 그것도 아주 많이.”
200|
201|“그럼…….”
202|
203|그녀는 망설임 없이 고개를 저었다.
204|
205|“미안해요. 제가 돈이나 유명세에 손바닥 뒤집듯 태도를 바꾸는 그런 사람은 아니거든요.”
206|
207|“아.”
208|
209|“솔직히 태경 씨 정도면 월척이긴 한데, 제 성격상 좋아하는 사람 생기면 한 번에 낚아 올리고 말지. 어장 같은 거 못 만들어요.”
210|
211|거침없이 할 말을 쏟아 낸 그녀가 눈을 깜빡였다.
212|
213|“아, 이제 곧 네임드 몬스터와 싸울 사람한테 너무 심한 말을 한 건 아니죠?”
214|
215|금붕어처럼 입만 벙긋거리던 나는 이내 피식 웃어 버렸다.
216|
217|“왜 웃어요?”
218|
219|“그냥. 참 시원시원하다 싶어서.”
220|
221|내 대답에 그녀가 눈을 가늘게 떴다.
222|
223|“어라, 갑자기 웬 반말?”
224|
225|“스물일곱이라며? 동갑내기니까 친구 정도는 괜찮잖아?”
226|
227|“흐음, 남녀관계에 친구는 없는데.”
228|
229|“그거야 그때 가서 생각해 볼 일이고.”
230|
231|망설이는 송송이에게 한마디를 덧붙였다.
232|
233|“같은 길드 동료니까.”
234|
235|“……그렇게 말하니까 안 받을 수가 없네.”
236|
237|나는 그녀를 보며 씩 웃었다.
238|
239|결국 보기 좋게 차인 꼴이 됐지만 일말의 후회도 없었고 한편으로는 덤덤했다.
240|
241|이런 모습을 보고 누군가 내게 정말 송송이를 좋아한 것이 맞냐고 묻는다면, 맞다. 그건 틀림없는 사실이다.
242|
243|다만 지금의 감정은 나도 확실하게 대답하기 힘들다.
244|
245|그냥…… 줄곧 마음에 담아 두었던 말을 했고, 답변과 상관없이 마음이 후련해졌을 뿐이다.
246|
247|지금은 이걸로 충분하지 않을까.
248|
249|“끝나고 소주나 한잔하자.”
250|
251|“우리 집 가훈이 남녀칠세부동석이야.”
252|
253|“다 같이.”
254|
255|“……어, 응.”
256|
257|나는 가벼운 발걸음으로 돌아섰다.
258|
259|동시에 등 뒤에서 느껴지는 엄청난 마나의 흐름. 직접 보지는 않았지만 김 집사가 마법의 보호막을 겹겹이 치고 있다는 것을 짐작할 수 있었다.
260|
261|‘부탁합니다.’
262|
263|그것은 전투가 임박했다는 뜻이었고, 실제로 작은 점에 불과했던 놈의 모습은 일반인의 육안으로도 확인할 수 있을 만큼 가까워져 있었다.
264|
265|“새끼, 많이 컸네.”
266|
267|어림잡아도 오십 미터가 훌쩍 넘어가는 몸통과 그보다 거대한 날개.
268|
269|전신을 빈틈없이 뒤덮은 흑색 비늘이 석양빛을 받아 번쩍거렸다.
270|
271|3년 전, 마지막으로 봤던 그때보다 족히 두세 배는 성장한 모습이었다.
272|
273|‘저게 가능한가?’
274|
275|지금까지 이런 경우는 들어 본 적이 없었다.
276|
277|하지만 틀림없었다. 희뿌옇게 물들어 있는 한쪽 눈이 바로 그 증거였다.
278|
279|붉게 물든 놈의 다른 눈동자가 정확히 나를 응시하고 있었다.
280|
281|- 크라아아아아!
282|
283|화아아악!
284|
285|단 한 번, 고함을 내지른 것만으로도 엄청난 바람이 불어닥친다. 황무지 곳곳에 깔려 있던 흙과 돌멩이가 자욱하게 솟아올랐다.
286|
287|먼지의 장막이 가라앉자 얼마 떨어지지 않은 언덕에 우뚝 서 있는 거대한 그림자가 보였다.
288|
289|‘크다.’
290|
291|그리고 강했다. 활짝 열린 감각으로 놈의 분노와 힘이 전해진다.
292|
293|A급의 울타리를 벗어난 괴물. 네임드 몬스터 다운 위용이었다.
294|
295|“드디어 만났구나.”
296|
297|비로소 놈과 마주하자 가슴이 떨렸다. 3년 전 그날, 나는 동료들을 잃었고 놈은 한쪽 눈을 잃었다.
298|
299|참으로 질긴 악연이다. 이제는 끝내야 했다.
300|
301|나는 서늘한 창대를 힘껏 움켜잡고 놈을 향해 천천히 걸음을 옮겼다.
302|
303|“오랜만이다. 나 기억하냐?”
304|
305|와이번은 분명 고등 생물이다.
306|
307|과거에도 교활하고 잔인했던 놈이니 네임드 몬스터가 된 지금, 더욱 강력한 힘과 뛰어난 지능까지 갖게 됐음은 당연지사였다.
308|
309|- 크르르르…….
310|
311|“기억하나 보네. 그래, 눈깔은 괜찮고?”
312|
313|하나 남은 눈동자에서 시뻘건 불길이 솟구친다. 나는 전신의 비늘을 바짝 곤두세운 놈을 보며 피식 웃었다.
314|
315|“이 썅노무 새끼가 어디서 하악질이야.”
316|
317|- 크르륵!
318|
319|한 걸음, 두 걸음.
320|
321|가슴이 뛰고 두뇌가 팽팽하게 회전한다. 놈의 몸뚱이를 난도질하고 숨통을 끊을 수백 가지의 투로(鬪路)가 눈앞에 펼쳐졌다.
322|
323|“널 보면 꼭 알려 주고 싶은 이름들이 있었거든. 귀 열고 똑똑히 들어라.”
324|
325|저벅, 저벅.
326|
327|놈과의 거리가 서서히 좁혀질수록 아랫배에서부터 뜨거운 뭔가가 울컥거렸다.
328|
329|작은 태양과 같은 그것은 어느덧 일 갑자를 넘어선 열양지기인 동시에 쌓이고 쌓여 덩어리가 되어 버린 분노였다.
330|
331|“김현수.”
332|
333|뿔테 안경을 낀 범생이의 얼굴이 눈앞에 선하다.
334|
335|헌터가 된 지 넉 달밖에 안 된 녀석은 첫 희생자였다. 놈이 휘두른 꼬리에 전신이 으스러졌다.
336|
337|몸은 둔했지만 열의는 넘쳐서 틈만 나면 나를 찾아와 묻고는 했다.
338|
339|
340|
341|‘부팀장님. 이건 어떻게 합니까?’
342|
343|‘부팀장님. 이 부분이 이해가 되지 않는데요.’
344|
345|‘부팀장님…….’
346|

[P64]
“I’ve never been fond of a turbulent life.”

[P65]
This time, Butler Kim answered with a smile.

[P66]
“For someone who feels that way, you seem to have come quite far.”

[P67]
“That’s why I changed it.”

[P68]
“Big and long. Is that right?”

[P69]
“Yes. It’s already too late for me to live small. Since things have turned out this way, I’m going to live as big and as long as I can.”

[P70]
“Good. If you wish, perhaps…”

[P71]
I knew what he was about to say.

[P72]
I quietly shook my head. Butler Kim had a far more important task to handle.

[P73]
“I’ll be fine. Protect the others.”

[P74]
“Understood. Even without being asked, I’ll do what must be done to the best of my ability.”

[P75]
At Butler Kim’s forthright answer, Song Song stared at us in disbelief.

[P76]
“You’re going to let him fight a Named Monster alone? Are you all out of your minds? One wrong move and we’ll all die. Every last one of us!”

[P77]
“Then why haven’t you left, Miss Song?”

[P78]
“…Good question. Why am I still here?”

[P79]
I watched her sink into thought, then spoke.

[P80]
“Miss Song.”

[P81]
“No.”

[P82]
“Absolutely not.”

[P83]
“Hunter Jin Taekyung. Please.”

[P84]
What was with these reactions?

[P85]
I had barely gotten her name out, yet Song Song, Team Leader Choi, and Butler Kim had all shut me down without hesitation.

[P86]
“Taekyung, go for it.”

[P87]
At least Kkeokjeong hyung was on my side.

[P88]
I looked at the other three with an aggrieved expression.

[P89]
“I haven’t even said anything yet.”

[P90]
Song Song answered,

[P91]
“That’s why I’m saying no.”

[P92]
“How do you know what I was going to say?”

[P93]
“Hmm. A confession?”

[P94]
My head went numb.

[P95]
The back of my skull throbbed as though someone had hit it with a hammer.

[P96]
“Wait. How did you know?”

[P97]
“Good grief. How could I not know?”

[P98]
“W-was it that obvious?”

[P99]
“Yes. Painfully.”

[P100]
“Then…”

[P101]
She shook her head without hesitation.

[P102]
“I’m sorry. I’m not the sort of person who changes her attitude at the drop of a hat just because someone has money or fame.”

[P103]
“Oh.”

[P104]
“To be honest, you’re quite a catch, Mr. Taekyung. But when I like someone, I’m the type to reel him in all at once. I can’t keep a whole pond stocked with men.”

[P105]
After letting everything out in one breath, she blinked.

[P106]
“Oh. I wasn’t too harsh on someone who’s about to fight a Named Monster, was I?”

[P107]
I had been opening and closing my mouth like a goldfish, but a quiet laugh soon escaped me.

[P108]
“Why are you laughing?”

[P109]
“No reason. I was just thinking how refreshingly straightforward you are.”

[P110]
She narrowed her eyes at my answer.

[P111]
“Hold on. Why are you suddenly speaking casually?”

[P112]
“You said you’re twenty-seven, right? We’re the same age. We can at least be friends, can’t we?”

[P113]
“Hmm. There’s no such thing as friendship between a man and a woman.”

[P114]
“We can worry about that if the time comes.”

[P115]
When Song Song still hesitated, I added,

[P116]
“We’re guildmates, after all.”

[P117]
“…When you put it that way, I can’t exactly refuse.”

[P118]
I grinned at her.

[P119]
In the end, I had been rejected cleanly, but I didn’t regret it in the slightest. If anything, I felt strangely calm.

[P120]
If someone saw me like this and asked whether I had really liked Song Song, the answer was yes. There was no question about that.

[P121]
But even I couldn’t say for certain what I felt now.

[P122]
I had simply said what I had kept buried in my heart for so long, and regardless of her answer, I felt relieved.

[P123]
Maybe that was enough for now.

[P124]
“Let’s have some soju when this is over.”

[P125]
“My family motto says boys and girls over seven shouldn’t sit together.”

[P126]
“I meant all of us.”

[P127]
“…Oh. Right.”

[P128]
I turned away with a light step.

[P129]
At that moment, I sensed an enormous flow of mana behind me. I didn’t need to look to know that Butler Kim was layering magical barriers around the others.

[P130]
*I’m counting on you.*

[P131]
It meant the battle was close at hand. Sure enough, the creature that had been no more than a tiny dot was now close enough for even an ordinary person to see clearly.

[P132]
“Bastard, you’ve gotten big.”

[P133]
Its body was easily over fifty meters long, and its wings were larger still.

[P134]
Black scales covered every inch of it, gleaming in the light of the setting sun.

[P135]
It had grown at least two or three times larger than when I had last seen it three years ago.

[P136]
*Was that even possible?*

[P137]
I had never heard of anything like it.

[P138]
But there was no mistaking the creature. Its clouded eye was proof.

[P139]
Its remaining eye, stained crimson, stared directly at me.

[P140]
—Kraaaaaaaah!

[P141]
Whoooosh!

[P142]
A single roar sent a tremendous gust crashing over the wasteland. Dirt and pebbles flew into the air, filling it with a thick cloud of dust.

[P143]
When the curtain of dust settled, a massive silhouette stood atop a nearby hill.

[P144]
*It’s huge.*

[P145]
And strong.

[P146]
With my senses stretched wide, I could feel its rage and power.

[P147]
It was a monster that had broken free of the bounds of A-Rank.

[P148]
It possessed all the might one would expect of a Named Monster.

[P149]
“So we finally meet.”

[P150]
Now that I stood face-to-face with it, my chest trembled. Three years ago, I had lost my comrades, and it had lost one eye.

[P151]
It had been a long, bitter grudge.

[P152]
Now it was time to end it.

[P153]
I tightened my grip on the cold spear shaft and slowly walked toward the creature.

[P154]
“Long time no see. Remember me?”

[P155]
Wyverns were unquestionably advanced creatures.

[P156]
It had been cunning and cruel even then. Now that it had become a Named Monster, it naturally possessed even greater strength and Intelligence.

[P157]
—Grrrrr…

[P158]
“Looks like you do. So, how’s the eye?”

[P159]
A crimson flame blazed in its remaining eye. I let out a quiet laugh as the scales across its body bristled.

[P160]
“You fucking bastard. Who the hell do you think you’re hissing at?”

[P161]
—Grrrk!

[P162]
One step.

[P163]
Then another.

[P164]
My heart pounded while my mind spun at full speed. Hundreds of ways to carve apart its body and snuff out its life unfolded before my eyes.

[P165]
“There were some names I wanted you to hear if I ever saw you again. Open your ears and listen carefully.”

[P166]
Step.

[P167]
Step.

[P168]
As the distance between us narrowed, something hot surged from my lower abdomen.

[P169]
It was like a small sun—the Scorching Yang Qi that had surpassed one jiazi[^1], and the rage that had built and built until it became something solid.

[P170]
[^1]: A *jiazi* is a traditional sixty-year cycle.

[P171]
“Kim Hyunsu.”

[P172]
The face of a straight-laced kid in horn-rimmed glasses appeared before my eyes.

[P173]
He had been a Hunter for only four months. He was the first to die. One sweep of the creature’s tail had crushed his entire body.

[P174]
He had been clumsy, but he never lacked enthusiasm. Whenever he had a spare moment, he would come find me with another question.

[P175]
*Deputy Team Leader. How do I do this?*

[P176]
*Deputy Team Leader. I don’t understand this part.*

[P177]
*Deputy Team Leader…*

[P178]
Sometimes, I thought about him.

[P179]
I wondered whether he might have survived if I had explained things more thoroughly, if I hadn’t been annoyed by the kid who came to me with dozens of questions every day.

[P180]
But regret always came too late. Kim Hyunsu had remained twenty forever, and his parents had wailed throughout the funeral for the only son they had lost.

[P181]
*Maybe they still are, even three years later.*

[P182]
There were nine more people like him.

[P183]
Every one of them had a family and dreams of their own.

[P184]
“Lee Hyerim. Song Donghyeok, Park Sangho, Kim Haneung, Park Gwanghyeon…”

[P185]
With every name, I took another step. With every step, memories of that person shimmered before me like heat haze.

[P186]
That was why my vision blurred.

[P187]
At least, that was what I chose to believe.

[P188]
After ten steps, only one name remained.

[P189]
“…And Hong Cheonsu.”

[P190]
The round face of a man in his thirties flashed before my eyes.

[P191]
When I first met him, I was a rookie Hunter barely twenty years old, while he was a ten-year veteran.

[P192]
After he saved me from being surrounded and nearly killed by goblins, I started calling him hyung.

[P193]
One perfectly ordinary day, I had suddenly asked him,

[P194]
*Why are you always so good to me?*

[P195]
He had answered,

[P196]
*I can’t stand watching a kid like you struggle. I have a youngest sibling about your age.*

[P197]
It wasn’t until the day of his funeral that I learned he had grown up in an orphanage and didn’t have a single relative.

[P198]
The absurdity of it made me laugh.

[P199]
In the end, though, I cried.

[P200]
Because I remembered his final words.

[P201]
*You cocky bastard. Taekyung, go on ahead.*

[P202]
That was how he—Cheonsu hyung—died.

[P203]
Leaving behind a wonderful spouse and three children.

[P204]
And now, at this very moment, I stood before the creature. I glared into its enormous red eye and opened my mouth.

[P205]
“Listen carefully, you fucking lizard bastard.”

[P206]
I had survived countless crises to say these words.

[P207]
After three years and ninety-two days, I was finally ready to tear off those wings and drive my spear through its heart.

[P208]
“This time, I’m not going anywhere.”

[P209]
Internal energy erupted from my dantian and surged through every limb and bone in my body.

[P210]
The Scorching Yang Qi raced unchecked toward the cold spearhead. The internal energy flowed in an unbroken stream, tangling like a skein of thread before transforming into something new.

[P211]
Crackle, crackle, crackle!

[P212]
Aura. Spear Energy.

[P213]
It didn’t matter what I called it. I leveled the blue-burning spearhead at the creature.

[P214]
“You’re…dead today.”

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.

- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.

The Star Guild might have had the advantage in numbers, but even without me, the Peace Guild wouldn’t be outmatched if they fought Won Myunghoon’s Guild right now.

[P35]
“That’s a convenient excuse.”

[P36]
Team Leader Choi stared at me as I smiled.

[P37]
“Mr. Jin Taekyung.”

[P38]
“No.”

[P39]
I cut him off before he could begin, but Team Leader Choi wasn’t the sort to back down quietly.

[P40]
“Since you’ve left me stuck here with nowhere to go, I think I’ve earned the right to ask a few questions.”

[P41]
*Damn. He has a point.*

[P42]
I answered reluctantly.

[P43]
“Fine…but keep it short.”

[P44]
“That monster coming toward us—is it connected to what happened three years ago?”

[P45]
I hesitated, then nodded.

[P46]
“You have no intention of retreating.”

[P47]
“…”

[P48]
My silence was answer enough.

[P49]
Team Leader Choi let out a low sigh.

[P50]
“Mr. Jin Taekyung, you’re facing a Named Monster.”

[P51]
“That’s news to me. All I see is something I need to kill.”

[P52]
“You need to think about this rationally.”

[P53]
“Do I look that unstable right now?”

[P54]
“That…”

[P55]
Team Leader Choi fell silent.

[P56]
I was calmer than I had ever been. My heart might have been hammering like mad, but my mind was running through countless ways to deal with the creature.

[P57]
“Team Leader Choi.”

[P58]
“…Yes?”

[P59]
“I’ve told you my motto in life a few times before, haven’t I?”

[P60]
Im Kkeokjeong, who had been watching in silence, answered for him.

[P61]
“Thin and long.”

[P62]
“You remember too, Uncle?”

[P63]
“You were a strange kid. Most young men dream big at least once…but you never did.”

[P64]
“I’ve never been fond of a turbulent life.”

[P65]
This time, Butler Kim answered with a smile.

[P66]
“For someone who feels that way, you seem to have come quite far.”

[P67]
“That’s why I changed it.”

[P68]
“Big and long. Is that right?”

[P69]
“Yes. It’s already too late for me to live small. Since things have turned out this way, I’m going to live as big and as long as I can.”

[P70]
“Good. If you wish, perhaps…”

[P71]
I knew what he was about to say.

[P72]
I quietly shook my head. Butler Kim had a far more important task to handle.

[P73]
“I’ll be fine. Protect the others.”

[P74]
“Understood. Even without being asked, I’ll do what must be done to the best of my ability.”

[P75]
At Butler Kim’s forthright answer, Song Song stared at us in disbelief.

[P76]
“You’re going to let him fight a Named Monster alone? Are you all out of your minds? One wrong move and we’ll all die. Every last one of us!”

[P77]
“Then why haven’t you left, Miss Song?”

[P78]
“…Good question. Why am I still here?”

[P79]
I watched her sink into thought, then spoke.

[P80]
“Miss Song.”

[P81]
“No.”

[P82]
“Absolutely not.”

[P83]
“Hunter Jin Taekyung. Please.”

[P84]
What was with these reactions?

[P85]
I had barely gotten her name out, yet Song Song, Team Leader Choi, and Butler Kim had all shut me down without hesitation.

[P86]
“Taekyung, go for it.”

[P87]
At least Kkeokjeong hyung was on my side.

[P88]
I looked at the other three with an aggrieved expression.

[P89]
“I haven’t even said anything yet.”

[P90]
Song Song answered,

[P91]
“That’s why I’m saying no.”

[P92]
“How do you know what I was going to say?”

[P93]
“Hmm. A confession?”

[P94]
My head went numb.

[P95]
The back of my skull throbbed as though someone had hit it with a hammer.

[P96]
“Wait. How did you know?”

[P97]
“Good grief. How could I not know?”

[P98]
“W-was it that obvious?”

[P99]
“Yes. Painfully.”

[P100]
“Then…”

[P101]
She shook her head without hesitation.

[P102]
“I’m sorry. I’m not the sort of person who changes her attitude at the drop of a hat just because someone has money or fame.”

[P103]
“Oh.”

[P104]
“To be honest, you’re quite a catch, Mr. Taekyung. But when I like someone, I’m the type to reel him in all at once. I can’t keep a whole pond stocked with men.”

[P105]
After letting everything out in one breath, she blinked.

[P106]
“Oh. I wasn’t too harsh on someone who’s about to fight a Named Monster, was I?”

[P107]
I had been opening and closing my mouth like a goldfish, but a quiet laugh soon escaped me.

[P108]
“Why are you laughing?”

[P109]
“No reason. I was just thinking how refreshingly straightforward you are.”

[P110]
She narrowed her eyes at my answer.

[P111]
“Hold on. Why are you suddenly speaking casually?”

[P112]
“You said you’re twenty-seven, right? We’re the same age. We can at least be friends, can’t we?”

[P113]
“Hmm. There’s no such thing as friendship between a man and a woman.”

[P114]
“We can worry about that if the time comes.”

[P115]
When Song Song still hesitated, I added,

[P116]
“We’re guildmates, after all.”

[P117]
“…When you put it that way, I can’t exactly refuse.”

[P118]
I grinned at her.

[P119]
In the end, I had been rejected cleanly, but I didn’t regret it in the slightest. If anything, I felt strangely calm.

[P120]
If someone saw me like this and asked whether I had really liked Song Song, the answer was yes. There was no question about that.

[P121]
But even I couldn’t say for certain what I felt now.

[P122]
I had simply said what I had kept buried in my heart for so long, and regardless of her answer, I felt relieved.

[P123]
Maybe that was enough for now.

[P124]
“Let’s have some soju when this is over.”

[P125]
“My family motto says boys and girls over seven shouldn’t sit together.”

[P126]
“I meant all of us.”

[P127]
“…Oh. Right.”

[P128]
I turned away with a light step.

[P129]
At that moment, I sensed an enormous flow of mana behind me. I didn’t need to look to know that Butler Kim was layering magical barriers around the others.

[P130]
*I’m counting on you.*

[P131]
It meant the battle was close at hand. Sure enough, the creature that had been no more than a tiny dot was now close enough for even an ordinary person to see clearly.

[P132]
“Bastard, you’ve gotten big.”

[P133]
Its body was easily over fifty meters long, and its wings were larger still.

[P134]
Black scales covered every inch of it, gleaming in the light of the setting sun.

[P135]
It had grown at least two or three times larger than when I had last seen it three years ago.

[P136]
*Was that even possible?*

[P137]
I had never heard of anything like it.

[P138]
But there was no mistaking the creature. Its clouded eye was proof.

[P139]
Its remaining eye, stained crimson, stared directly at me.

[P140]
—Kraaaaaaaah!

[P141]
Whoooosh!

[P142]
A single roar sent a tremendous gust crashing over the wasteland. Dirt and pebbles flew into the air, filling it with a thick cloud of dust.

[P143]
When the curtain of dust settled, a massive silhouette stood atop a nearby hill.

[P144]
*It’s huge.*

[P145]
And strong.

[P146]
With my senses stretched wide, I could feel its rage and power.

[P147]
It was a monster that had broken free of the bounds of A-Rank.

[P148]
It possessed all the might one would expect of a Named Monster.

[P149]
“So we finally meet.”

[P150]
Now that I stood face-to-face with it, my chest trembled. Three years ago, I had lost my comrades, and it had lost one eye.

[P151]
It had been a long, bitter grudge.

[P152]
Now it was time to end it.

[P153]
I tightened my grip on the cold spear shaft and slowly walked toward the creature.

[P154]
“Long time no see. Remember me?”

[P155]
Wyverns were unquestionably advanced creatures.

[P156]
It had been cunning and cruel even then. Now that it had become a Named Monster, it naturally possessed even greater strength and Intelligence.

[P157]
—Grrrrr…

[P158]
“Looks like you do. So, how’s the eye?”

[P159]
A crimson flame blazed in its remaining eye. I let out a quiet laugh as the scales across its body bristled.

[P160]
“You fucking bastard. Who the hell do you think you’re hissing at?”

[P161]
—Grrrk!

[P162]
One step.

[P163]
Then another.

[P164]
My heart pounded while my mind spun at full speed. Hundreds of ways to carve apart its body and snuff out its life unfolded before my eyes.

[P165]
“There were some names I wanted you to hear if I ever saw you again. Open your ears and listen carefully.”

[P166]
Step.

[P167]
Step.

[P168]
As the distance between us narrowed, something hot surged from my lower abdomen.

[P169]
It was like a small sun—the Scorching Yang Qi that had surpassed one jiazi[^1], and the rage that had built and built until it became something solid.

[P170]
[^1]: A *jiazi* is a traditional sixty-year cycle.

[P171]
“Kim Hyunsu.”

[P172]
The face of a straight-laced kid in horn-rimmed glasses appeared before my eyes.

[P173]
He had been a Hunter for only four months. He was the first to die. One sweep of the creature’s tail had crushed his entire body.

[P174]
He had been clumsy, but he never lacked enthusiasm. Whenever he had a spare moment, he would come find me with another question.

[P175]
*Deputy Team Leader. How do I do this?*

[P176]
*Deputy Team Leader. I don’t understand this part.*

[P177]
*Deputy Team Leader…*

[P178]
Sometimes, I thought about him.

[P179]
I wondered whether he might have survived if I had explained things more thoroughly, if I hadn’t been annoyed by the kid who came to me with dozens of questions every day.

[P180]
But regret always came too late. Kim Hyunsu had remained twenty forever, and his parents had wailed throughout the funeral for the only son they had lost.

[P181]
*Maybe they still are, even three years later.*

[P182]
There were nine more people like him.

[P183]
Every one of them had a family and dreams of their own.

[P184]
“Lee Hyerim. Song Donghyeok, Park Sangho, Kim Haneung, Park Gwanghyeon…”

[P185]
With every name, I took another step. With every step, memories of that person shimmered before me like heat haze.

[P186]
That was why my vision blurred.

[P187]
At least, that was what I chose to believe.

[P188]
After ten steps, only one name remained.

[P189]
“…And Hong Cheonsu.”

[P190]
The round face of a man in his thirties flashed before my eyes.

[P191]
When I first met him, I was a rookie Hunter barely twenty years old, while he was a ten-year veteran.

[P192]
After he saved me from being surrounded and nearly killed by goblins, I started calling him hyung.

[P193]
One perfectly ordinary day, I had suddenly asked him,

[P194]
*Why are you always so good to me?*

[P195]
He had answered,

[P196]
*I can’t stand watching a kid like you struggle. I have a youngest sibling about your age.*

[P197]
It wasn’t until the day of his funeral that I learned he had grown up in an orphanage and didn’t have a single relative.

[P198]
The absurdity of it made me laugh.

[P199]
In the end, though, I cried.

[P200]
Because I remembered his final words.

[P201]
*You cocky bastard. Taekyung, go on ahead.*

[P202]
That was how he—Cheonsu hyung—died.

[P203]
Leaving behind a wonderful spouse and three children.

[P204]
And now, at this very moment, I stood before the creature. I glared into its enormous red eye and opened my mouth.

[P205]
“Listen carefully, you fucking lizard bastard.”

[P206]
I had survived countless crises to say these words.

[P207]
After three years and ninety-two days, I was finally ready to tear off those wings and drive my spear through its heart.

[P208]
“This time, I’m not going anywhere.”

[P209]
Internal energy erupted from my dantian and surged through every limb and bone in my body.

[P210]
The Scorching Yang Qi raced unchecked toward the cold spearhead. The internal energy flowed in an unbroken stream, tangling like a skein of thread before transforming into something new.

[P211]
Crackle, crackle, crackle!

[P212]
Aura. Spear Energy.

[P213]
It didn’t matter what I called it. I leveled the blue-burning spearhead at the creature.

[P214]
“You’re…dead today.”

# Adjudication Task — Chapter 220

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃220화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|원명훈이 떠났다. 내 태도에 이를 갈면서도 선뜻 덤비지 못하던 그의 모습을 떠올리자 실소가 새어 나왔다.
  6|
  7|‘그랬다면 후회하게 만들어 줬을 텐데.’
  8|
  9|하이에나 같은 인간이다.
 10|
 11|상대가 약한 모습을 보이면 이빨을 드러내고, 강한 모습을 보이면 이빨을 감춘다.
 12|
 13|지금까지 보여 준 모습을 되짚어 보면 8년 전의 그 사건도 그의 성향과 무관하지 않을 것이다.
 14|
 15|‘운 좋은 줄 알아라.’
 16|
 17|하이에나가 아무리 날고 기어 봤자 결국 짐승.
 18|
 19|꼬리를 내릴 줄 아는 놈은 겁을 줘서 쫓아내면 그만이다.
 20|
 21|내 어깨에 이빨을 박기도 전에 굳이 손에 피를 묻힐 이유도, 생각도 없었다. 짐승 따위가 아니라 진짜 괴물을 상대하기 전에는 더더욱.
 22|
 23|- 캬우우우우우!
 24|
 25|조금씩 가까워지는 검은 점.
 26|
 27|분노에 찬 포효가 지평선 끝에서부터 울려 퍼졌다.
 28|
 29|내가 놈의 정체를 알아차린 것처럼, 놈도 마찬가지였다.
 30|
 31|‘그래, 너도 나를 기억하는구나.’
 32|
 33|그거면 된 거다. 반쯤 미친 네임드 몬스터를 상대하게 됐지만 두려움과 흥분은 없었다.
 34|
 35|다만 한 가지, 목 안의 가시처럼 걸리는 부분이 있었다.
 36|
 37|“왜 안 가셨어요?”
 38|
 39|느슨하게 팔짱을 낀 최 팀장이 나를 빤히 바라봤다.
 40|
 41|곧이어 돌아온 건 대답이 아니라 질문이었다.
 42|
 43|“누구한테 물어본 겁니까?”
 44|
 45|“모두한테요.”
 46|
 47|나는 주위를 쓱 훑었다. 끝없이 펼쳐진 황무지, 드문드문 늘어선 바위와 나무를 배경으로 네 사람이 서 있었다.
 48|
 49|최 팀장과 김 집사. 그리고 임꺽정과 송송이.
 50|
 51|그들 중 단 한 사람도 자리를 뜨지 않았다.
 52|
 53|“지금 오고 있는 게 네임드 몬스터인 건 아시죠?”
 54|
 55|“저희 모두 잘 알고 있습니다.”
 56|
 57|“그럼 이야기가 쉽겠네요. 위험하니까 지금이라도 피하세요.”
 58|
 59|“어디로 피합니까?”
 60|
 61|“어디겠어요? 우리가 들어왔던 출구지.”
 62|
 63|“스타 길드는 같이 도망치기에 썩 괜찮은 파트너는 아니죠. 더군다나 그쪽 길드장이랑 척을 졌을 경우에는.”
 64|
 65|글쎄, 내 생각은 다른데.
 66|
 67|아직 알려지지는 않았지만 김 집사는 A급 마법사다. 그것도 대격변이라는 초유의 전쟁을 온몸으로 겪은.
 68|
 69|머릿수만 많았지, 당장 나를 제외하고 원명훈이 이끄는 스타 길드와 싸워도 결코 밀리지 않는다.
 70|
 71|“핑계가 좋네요.”
 72|
 73|빙긋 웃는 나를 최 팀장이 빤히 응시했다.
 74|
 75|“진태경 씨.”
 76|
 77|“안 돼요.”
 78|
 79|말이 나오기도 전에 단칼에 잘라 냈지만 이대로 순순히 물러날 최 팀장이 아니었다.
 80|
 81|“덕분에 오도 가도 못 하는 상황에 처했으니 몇 가지 정도는 물어볼 자격이 있다고 생각하는데요.”
 82|
 83|젠장, 그러네.
 84|
 85|나는 마지못해 대답했다.
 86|
 87|“……대신 짧게.”
 88|
 89|“지금 오고 있는 저 몬스터, 3년 전 그 일과 연관이 있는 놈입니까?”
 90|
 91|망설이다가 고개를 끄덕였다.
 92|
 93|“물러서지 않겠군요.”
 94|
 95|“…….”
 96|
 97|침묵은 곧 긍정.
 98|
 99|최 팀장이 낮게 한숨을 내쉬었다.
100|
101|“진태경 씨, 상대는 네임드 몬스터입니다.”
102|
103|“그건 처음 알았네요. 제 눈에는 그냥 죽일 놈인데.”
104|
105|“이건 냉정하게 생각해야 할 문제입니다.”
106|
107|“지금 제가 그 정도로 불안정해 보입니까?”
108|
109|“그건…….”
110|
111|최 팀장은 입을 다물었다.
112|
113|지금의 나는 그 어느 때보다 냉정하다. 미친 듯이 방망이질 치는 심장과는 달리 머릿속에서는 놈을 상대할 방법을 수없이 떠올리고 있다.
114|
115|“최 팀장님.”
116|
117|“……?”
118|
119|“제 인생 모토, 예전에 몇 번 말씀드린 적이 있었죠.”
120|
121|말없이 지켜보던 임꺽정이 대신 대답했다.
122|
123|“가늘고 길게.”
124|
125|“아저씨도 기억하시네요.”
126|
127|“넌 희한한 놈이었어. 젊은 녀석이면 한 번쯤 큰 꿈을 가져 볼 만도 한데…… 그러지 않았지.”
128|
129|“제가 굴곡진 인생은 별로 안 좋아해서.”
130|
131|이번에는 김 집사가 미소짓는 얼굴로 대답했다.
132|
133|“그런 것 치고는 멀리 와 버린 것 같군요.”
134|
135|“그래서 바꿨죠.”
136|
137|“굵고 길게. 맞습니까?”
138|
139|“네. 가늘게 살기에는 이미 글렀고, 이렇게 된 이상 최대한 굵고 길게 살아 보려고요.”
140|
141|“좋군요. 혹시 원하신다면…….”
142|
143|무슨 말을 할지 알 것 같다.
144|
145|나는 가만히 고개를 가로저었다. 김 집사는 더욱 중요한 일을 맡아야 하는 사람이다.
146|
147|“저는 괜찮습니다. 다른 분들을 지켜 주세요.”
148|
149|“알겠습니다. 굳이 말씀하지 않으셔도 제가 마땅히 해야 할 일, 최선을 다하죠.”
150|
151|김 집사의 시원시원한 대답에 송이 씨가 황당한 얼굴로 물었다.
152|
153|“네임드 몬스터를 상대로 혼자 싸우라니, 다들 제정신이에요? 까딱하면 다 죽어요, 다!”
154|

## Adjudicator rules

# Mastering Adjudicator Brief

You are a **veto**, not a second novelist and not a gloss writer.

This call is isolated, non-interactive, and tool-free. The packet already contains the Korean source, both complete English versions, glossary matches, rules, and every numbered hunk. Do not call tools, search the repository, or read files. Do not announce a plan.

The first editor (SOL) has already rewritten the accepted English (BASELINE) for fluency. Default is `SOL`. Take `BASE` only when SOL is actually unfaithful. Write `REPAIR` only when **both** BASE and SOL are unfaithful.

## Default

Choose `SOL` unless a veto below fires.

Keep SOL when it is slangier, punchier, more spoken, or more idiomatic and the Korean sense holds (`기만질` → “con me”, `톡톡히` → “full Peak Master treatment”, `득실거리다` → “crawling with”, `인간 백정` → “butcher of men”, `한 몸` → “are one”, `시원하다` in a bath → “That’s the stuff”, `어렵게 찾아오고 쉽게 깨지는 법` → “hard-won and easily broken”). If SOL already naturalized Korean syntax (`이 혁무진` → “I, Hyuk Mujin”), keep SOL. Do not reproduce Korean word order.

**Literal closeness to Korean wording is not fidelity.** Preserve the source’s meaning and effect in natural English.

## Veto — choose `BASE`

Use `BASE` only for a real miss:

* wrong denotation, quantity, hedge, category, subject/object, or physical action
* a different English idiom than the Korean joke (`까발리다` ≠ “gives someone away”; `넉살` ≠ “banter”)
* a rebuilt joke whose comic machine BASE already has (`얼마나 …는지 …겠다` must stay a simple exaggeration: “snored so loudly even my mother in Ilsan probably heard him,” not “You had to wonder how loudly…”)
* dropped image, attitude, or timing
* SOL replaces an established project rendering, System label, or Markdown convention with an unsupported synonym
* SOL stamps `hyung` (or another kinship title) onto every narrative name when BASE already uses the name and the Korean `형` is ordinary reference, not a vocative or a topical joke (`진호 형` → Jinho in narration)

Do not veto SOL for being informal. Do not veto SOL to “clarify” slang. Do not veto SOL merely because BASELINE is already understandable.

## `REPAIR` only when both fail

Example: `겹경사가 따로 없다` means two good things **together** (double blessing). `따로` is not “separate.” If BASE says “entirely separate stroke of luck” and SOL says “unexpected windfall,” `REPAIR` to stacked luck.

Do not `REPAIR` a working SOL line. Do not invent a third style because you prefer it.

For `REPAIR`, write the smallest complete replacement needed for that hunk. It must be natural English and fully source-faithful.

## Glossary

Korean **keys** are binding unless the source uses that string in a different ordinary-language sense. Glossary **English** is not a license for a calque (`presiding chair`). If SOL is a natural recast of the same sense, keep SOL.

Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown fence or prose:

Reasons must name the veto, or say that SOL keeps sense and voice. Do not merely say one version is "better" or "more natural" without stating what changed.

Keep reasons brief. Do not adjudicate unchanged passages. Do not call tools.

## Critical binding translation rules

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

## Footnotes

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:

- a Korean institution, living arrangement, food, holiday, myth, historical reference, or local custom;
- a Korean word, phrase, idiom, wordplay, or culturally specific image that cannot be conveyed fully by the best natural English analogy;
- a deliberately literal rendering whose cultural or linguistic force would otherwise be lost.

For example, render `고시원` as “goshiwon” when the setting or connotations matter, with a concise footnote explaining that it is a very small, inexpensive room-for-rent housing arrangement. Prefer the best natural English analogy in the prose. Use a literal translation plus a concise footnote when the Korean wording itself matters. Define a term at its first meaningful occurrence and do not repeat the note unnecessarily. Footnotes must be rare, useful, and non-spoiling; do not footnote ordinary vocabulary, fully preserved jokes, or uncertainty. Record consequential uncertainty in `docs/STATE.md`.

## Spoilers and Scope

- Safe profiles contain only facts revealed through the latest completed chapter.
- Never read `characters/spoilers/` during drafting. Reviewers may consult one relevant sealed profile only for a specific unresolved continuity issue after the draft is complete.
- Future knowledge may prevent contradiction but may not add early names, pronouns, certainty, motives, or foreshadowing.
- Translate exactly one requested chapter unless the user explicitly requests a batch. Never modify Korean source files under `source/`.
